title: UAP data withheld to protect classified sensor capabilities

tellings.quote:
>> And so I have no doubt that some of the
reluctance to release some of the stuff
it was captured by a collection system
that we don't want people to know we
have.

plain: Part of the reason the government holds back its UFO material, by this account, is to hide the secret sensors that recorded it. Eric Haseltine, a former senior NSA official, tells Michels he has "no doubt" that some of the reluctance to release records of UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs) comes from the fact that they were "captured by a collection system that we don't want people to know we have." If he is right, some of the secrecy is about guarding spying technology, not about what was seen.
